title: 第110章 真君转世第109章 天坠
content_zh:
第110章真君转世？
金色的火焰在幽府道人的魂体上肆意翻滚，那股属于九幽玄都渡厄真君的高邈气机跨越虚空，强行挤入这方残缺的秘境。
这门术法乃是幽府道人此世摸索出的一种歪门邪道。
借由燃烧千年积攒的大半香火愿力，强行撬动前世真君的因果，换取一次跨越时间长河的出手。
此番之威代价极大，他这缕分魂注定会在此击后彻底崩灭。
用来对付一个炼气期的外来者，简直是杀鸡用牛刀。
但此刻他也没有其他的办法。
“我就不相信，这次还拿不下你！”幽府道人怒喝出声。
半空中，虚空壁垒如镜面般破碎。
下一刻，一只虚幻的巨手从裂缝中探出，食指并拢，朝着苏阎所在的位置一指点下。
这一指，超越了筑基期的界限，带着抹杀一切生灵的绝强威压。
炼气的极限在筑基面前不值一提。
那筑基的极限在真君面前呢？
答案不言而喻。
一股死亡的威胁瞬间的笼罩苏阎全身，见此一幕，苏阎咬了咬牙随即催动起体内的先天真炁。
既然逃不掉也挡不住，那他只好放手一搏。
大不了再折损一条替死化身。
这道先天真炁耗费就耗费了，先把小命留住才是最要紧的。
但就在苏阎强行调动那先天真炁的刹那，停留在气种深处的那道无名剑气，突然生出了异动。
它似乎是感受到了外界那股属于九幽玄都渡厄真君的气机。

铮！
下一刻，一声清越的剑鸣在苏阎体内炸响。
随后那道剑气直接挣脱了气种的束缚，顺着苏阎的经脉逆流而上，从他的丹田处悍然窜出。
刹那间，一道长达百丈的雪白剑芒贯穿天地，迎着上方压下的那一指斩了过去。
轰！！
两股力量在半空中碰撞的瞬间，整个幽都秘境为之一颤。
那只穿透虚空的虚幻巨掌，被这一线银白剑气从中间劈开。
九幽玄都渡厄真君的气机四处溃散，光华零落。
“什么！”
幽府道人双眼圆睁，眼角因极度的惊恐而崩裂，魂体剧烈摇晃。
“真君剑气！”
他失声惊呼，声音里透着难以掩饰的战栗。
这小子的身上为何会藏有真君剑气！？
难道对方也是真君转世？
这个念头刚一升起，幽府道人的心直坠谷底。
难怪。
难怪这小子敢闯入幽都，敢当着他的面拆毁神像，连面对筑基层面的绝杀都面不改色。
原来大家都是同道中人。
他万万没想到，自己蛰伏千年布下的局，居然会被另一位真君转世给盯上。
早知如此，当时苏阎提出借阅大神通的提议，他就该顺坡下驴答应下来！

一门大神通的法门，换取一个真君转世的死磕。
这个交易，他算是彻底掀了桌，把自己赔了个底朝天。
想到这他顿时后悔不已。
自己这燃烧大半香火愿力换来的这一击，对付炼气修士绰绰有余，但在同级别的真君剑气面前，根本不够看。
content_en:
Chapter 110 The reincarnation of the true king?
Golden flames rolled wantonly on the soul of Taoist Youfu, and the high-end Qi machine belonging to True Lord Du'e of Jiuyou Xuandu crossed the void and forced its way into the incomplete secret realm.
This technique is a crooked way discovered by Taoist Taoist Master Youfu in this life.
By burning most of the incense and wish power accumulated over thousands of years, he forcibly leveraged the cause and effect of the true king in his previous life in exchange for a move that spanned the long river of time.
The price of this power is extremely high, and his split soul is destined to completely collapse after this attack.
Used to deal with an outsider who is in the Qi refining stage, it is simply killing a chicken with a sledgehammer.
But he had no other option at the moment.
"I don't believe it. I can't defeat you this time!" Taoist Master Youfu shouted angrily.
In midair, the void barrier shattered like a mirror.
The next moment, an illusory giant hand poked out from the crack, put its index fingers together, and pointed towards Su Yan's location.
This finger transcends the boundaries of the Foundation Establishment Stage and carries the overwhelming pressure to obliterate all living creatures.
The limits of Qi refining are not worth mentioning in front of foundation building.
Then what is the limit of foundation building in front of True Lord?
The answer is self-evident.
A threat of death instantly enveloped Su Yan's body. Seeing this scene, Su Yan gritted his teeth and immediately activated the innate energy in his body.
Since he couldn't escape or stop him, he had no choice but to give it a try.
At worst, one more surrogate incarnation would be lost.
This innate energy is wasted when it is wasted, and the most important thing is to save your life first.
But at the moment when Su Yan forcibly mobilized the innate energy, the nameless sword energy that stayed in the depths of the energy suddenly started to move.
It seems to have sensed the energy from the outside world belonging to True Monarch Du'e of Jiuyou Xuandu.
Zheng!
The next moment, a clear sword cry exploded in Su Yan's body.
Then the sword energy broke free from the shackles of the energy, flowed upstream along Su Yan's meridians, and burst out from his Dantian.
In an instant, a hundred-foot-long snow-white sword light pierced through the sky and the earth, slashing towards the finger pressing down from above.
boom! !
The moment the two forces collided in mid-air, the entire Youdu Secret Realm trembled.
The illusory giant palm that penetrated the void was split in the middle by this silver-white sword energy.
The Qi of Jiuyou Xuandu Du'e Zhenjun collapsed in all directions, and his brilliance was scattered.
"What!"
Taoist Youfu's eyes widened, the corners of his eyes cracked due to extreme fear, and his soul shook violently.
"True Lord Sword Qi!"
He exclaimed in surprise, with unconcealable trembling in his voice.
Why does this kid have True Lord Sword Qi hidden in his body! ?
Could it be that the other party is also the reincarnation of the True King?
As soon as this thought arose, Taoist Youfu's heart plummeted to the bottom.
No wonder.
No wonder this kid dared to break into Youdu, dared to tear down the statues in front of him, and even faced the ultimate attack at the foundation level without changing his expression.
It turns out that everyone is of the same mind.
He never expected that the trap he had set up after lying dormant for thousands of years would actually be targeted by the reincarnation of another True Lord.
If he had known this, when Su Yan proposed to borrow the supernatural power, he should have just agreed!
A great magical power, in exchange for the death of a true king reincarnated.
In this transaction, he completely overturned the table and lost everything.
Thinking of this, he immediately regretted it.
The blow I got by burning most of my incense and will energy was more than enough to deal with the Qi Refining monks, but it was not enough in front of the True Lord Sword Qi of the same level.
